players.product: EDA software and chip design simulation tools accelerated by NVIDIA CUDA

quarterly_data.signal: Contracted but unsatisfied or partially unsatisfied performance obligations (backlog) were approximately $11.4 billion as of October 31, 2025, including $2.0 billion of non-cancellable Flexible Spending Account (FSA) commitments; approximately 45% of the backlog excluding non-cancellable FSA is expected to be recognized as revenue over the next 12 months. Backlog was approximately $8.1 billion as of October 31, 2024, including $1.2 billion of FSA commitments.
quarterly_data.figure: backlog ~$11.4 billion as of October 31, 2025 (incl. $2.0 billion FSA) vs ~$8.1 billion as of October 31, 2024; ~45% ex-FSA in next 12 months

players.product: Semiconductor IP (interface / foundation IP) supplied to ASIC design houses under an IP OEM partnership (Gaonchips supplier)

quarterly_data.signal: The 10-K attributes weakness in the Design IP segment in fiscal 2025 to China export control restrictions (including the Q3 2025 BIS Restrictions) that disrupted customer design starts in China, weaker than expected demand from a major foundry customer (not named), and roadmap and resource decisions that did not yield their intended results. Synopsys says it has begun reallocating resources to the highest growth opportunities in Design IP but expects muted growth in fiscal 2026.
